title: ShortsGuard — keep Facebook, YouTube, Instagram & Messenger, drop Reels/Shorts

honest_limit.en: DNS resolves domain names, nothing else. facebook.com/reel/123, youtube.com/shorts/abc and instagram.com/reels/xyz all live on the SAME domains as the normal feed. No DNS resolver on earth can block a path — and blocking fbcdn.net / cdninstagram.com / googlevideo.com to kill short videos also kills every photo, video, story and Messenger attachment. So ShortsGuard blocks the short-video SURFACES inside the page (userscript, extension or content blocker) and uses DNS only for whole-app blocks and normal ad/malware/adult filtering.
honest_limit.bn: DNS শুধু ডোমেইন নাম resolve করে। facebook.com/reel/123, youtube.com/shorts/abc, instagram.com/reels/xyz — সবই স্বাভাবিক ফিডের একই ডোমেইনে থাকে। কোনো DNS দিয়েই শুধু path ব্লক করা সম্ভব না। আর শর্ট ভিডিও আটকাতে fbcdn.net বা cdninstagram.com ব্লক করলে ফেসবুক/ইনস্টাগ্রামের সব ছবি, ভিডিও, স্টোরি আর Messenger-এর অ্যাটাচমেন্টও ভেঙে যাবে। তাই ShortsGuard পেজের ভেতরে Reels/Shorts লুকিয়ে/রিডাইরেক্ট করে (userscript / extension / content blocker), আর DNS শুধু পুরো অ্যাপ ব্লক ও অ্যাড/ম্যালওয়্যার/অ্যাডাল্ট ফিল্টারিং-এর জন্য ব্যবহার করে।

profiles.name: Focus Mode
profiles.tagline: Reels & Shorts surfaces gone. Feeds, DMs, Messenger and normal YouTube videos keep working.
profiles.tagline_bn: Reels ও Shorts সেকশন বন্ধ; ফিড, DM, Messenger আর সাধারণ ইউটিউব ভিডিও সবই চলবে।
does: Hides the Shorts shelf, Shorts tab, Shorts search results and Reels tabs/shelves.
Redirects /shorts/<id> to the normal watch page so a shared link still plays.
Redirects /reel/ and /reels/ URLs to the home feed.
Never touches /messages, messenger.com, /direct/ or any media CDN.
install: Install the userscript (Tampermonkey / Violentmonkey) — one file, no build step.
Or install the uBlock Origin / AdGuard cosmetic ruleset.
Or load the bundled MV3 extension in Chrome/Edge/Brave.

profiles.name: Focus + Filtered DNS
profiles.tagline: Focus Mode plus a filtered resolver: ads, trackers and malware blocked for every app on the device.
profiles.tagline_bn: Focus Mode + ফিল্টার করা DNS — ফোনের সব অ্যাপে অ্যাড, ট্র্যাকার ও ম্যালওয়্যার ব্লক।
does: Everything Focus Mode does, in the browser.
Adds device-wide DNS filtering (ads, trackers, malware) at the resolver level.
install: Pick a filtered resolver from the Resolvers tab (e.g. dns.adguard-dns.com).
Then install the Focus Mode userscript or uBlock rules.

profiles.name: DNS Hard Block (opt-in)
profiles.tagline: Blocks entire short-video apps at the DNS level — only for apps you are willing to lose.
profiles.tagline_bn: পুরো শর্ট-ভিডিও অ্যাপ DNS লেভেলে ব্লক — যে অ্যাপ না থাকলেও চলে, শুধু সেগুলোর জন্য।
does: Blocks TikTok / Likee / Kwai / SnackVideo completely (app + website).
Does NOT block Facebook Reels, Instagram Reels or YouTube Shorts — impossible at DNS level.
Facebook, Messenger, Instagram and YouTube keep working.
install: Use the hosts / AdGuard Home / dnsmasq blocklist below on your router or Pi-hole.
Do not add fbcdn.net, cdninstagram.com or googlevideo.com — that breaks normal media.

profiles.name: Family Safe
profiles.tagline: Adult + malware DNS filter, plus Reels/Shorts hidden on every browser profile.
profiles.tagline_bn: অ্যাডাল্ট ও ম্যালওয়্যার DNS ফিল্টার, সঙ্গে সব ব্রাউজারে Reels/Shorts বন্ধ।
does: Device-wide adult + malware blocking through the resolver.
Short-video surfaces hidden in the browser.
SafeSearch enforced by the resolver where the provider supports it.
install: Set family.cloudflare-dns.com or dns-family.adguard.com as Private DNS / DoH.
Install the Focus Mode userscript or uBlock rules on every browser profile.

profiles.name: Kids Guard
profiles.tagline: Ads, trackers, malware and adult content blocked for every app, SafeSearch where supported, and Reels/Shorts hidden in the browser.
profiles.tagline_bn: সব অ্যাপে অ্যাড, ট্র্যাকার, ম্যালওয়্যার ও অ্যাডাল্ট কনটেন্ট ব্লক; SafeSearch চালু; ব্রাউজারে Reels/Shorts লুকানো।
does: Device-wide ad, tracker, malware and adult-content filtering through the resolver.
SafeSearch enforced where the provider supports it (AdGuard Family / Cloudflare Family).
Reels and Shorts surfaces hidden; normal feeds, videos, DMs and Messenger stay.
Optional extra: add the DNS Hard Block list to remove TikTok / Likee / Kwai / SnackVideo completely.
install: Set dns-family.adguard.com (ads + adult + SafeSearch) or family.cloudflare-dns.com (malware + adult) as Private DNS.
Want ads + gambling blocked too? Use Kahf Guard's medium.kahfguard.com (DoT/DoH) — see the DNS System tab → Kahf Guard.
Install the Focus Mode userscript or uBlock rules on every browser profile.
For a managed home network use the Full DNS System tab → Kids Guard.

targets.note: Never blocked by any ShortsGuard profile.
Same domain and same CDN (fbcdn.net) as the feed — only the page can hide it.
messenger.com and /messages are explicitly allowlisted. Media CDNs are never blocked.
youtube.com/shorts is a path on the main domain; googlevideo.com serves normal videos too.
cdninstagram.com serves every photo and story too.
TikTok is 100% short video — there is no non-Reels part to keep.

rules.ublock:
! Title: ShortsGuard — Focus Mode (YouTube Shorts · Facebook Reels · Instagram Reels)
! Description: Hides short-form video surfaces; feeds, DMs and Messenger keep working.
! Version: 1.0.0
! Expires: 7 days
! Homepage: https://github.com/iamtanzir/DNS-Server-List

! ===== YouTube Shorts =====
youtube.com##ytd-reel-shelf-renderer
youtube.com##ytm-reel-shelf-renderer
youtube.com##ytd-rich-shelf-renderer[is-shorts]
youtube.com##ytd-rich-section-renderer:has(ytd-rich-shelf-renderer[is-shorts])
youtube.com##ytd-reel-video-renderer
youtube.com##ytd-shorts
youtube.com##ytm-shorts-lockup-view-model
youtube.com##ytd-guide-entry-renderer:has(a[title="Shorts"])
youtube.com##ytd-mini-guide-entry-renderer[aria-label="Shorts"]
youtube.com##yt-tab-shape[tab-title="Shorts"]
youtube.com##yt-chip-cloud-chip-renderer:has(yt-formatted-string[title="Shorts"])
youtube.com##ytd-video-renderer:has(a#thumbnail[href^="/shorts/"])
youtube.com##ytd-grid-video-renderer:has(a#thumbnail[href^="/shorts/"])
youtube.com##yt-lockup-view-model:has(a[href^="/shorts/"])
youtube.com##grid-shelf-view-model:has(a[href^="/shorts/"])
youtube.com##ytd-comment-thread-renderer:has(a[href^="/shorts/"])

! ===== Facebook Reels =====
facebook.com##a[href*="/reel/"]
facebook.com##a[href*="sk=reels_tab"]
facebook.com##div[aria-label="Reels"]
facebook.com##div[aria-label="Reels and short videos"]
facebook.com##div[data-pagelet^="Reels"]
facebook.com##div[data-pagelet*="Reel"]
facebook.com##div[role="navigation"] a[href*="/reel/"]
facebook.com##div[role="feed"] div:has(> div a[href*="/reel/"])

! ===== Instagram Reels =====
instagram.com##a[href="/reels/"]
instagram.com##a[href^="/reels/"]
instagram.com##a[href*="/reel/"]
instagram.com##a:has(svg[aria-label="Reels"])
instagram.com##div[aria-label="Reels"]
instagram.com##div[role="tablist"] a[href="/reels/"]
instagram.com##article:has(a[href*="/reel/"])

install_guides.title: Userscript (fastest, all browsers)
steps: Open guard/shorts-guard.user.js and click Raw — the manager offers Install.
Open youtube.com, facebook.com and instagram.com once to confirm the badge appears.
Toggle any target from the script menu (ShortsGuard → settings).

install_guides.title: uBlock Origin (no extra extension if you already use it)
steps: Open the uBlock Origin dashboard → My filters.
Paste blocklists/shortsguard-ublock.txt and click Apply changes.
Reload the three sites. Reels/Shorts shelves disappear; URLs still work.

install_guides.title: Bundled Chrome / Edge extension (MV3)
steps: Open chrome://extensions and enable Developer mode.
Load unpacked → select the guard/extension folder.
Pin ShortsGuard and use the popup to toggle YouTube / Facebook / Instagram.

install_guides.title: AdGuard Home / Pi-hole (whole network, apps only)
steps: AdGuard Home → Filters → DNS blocklists → Add blocklist → paste the raw URL of blocklists/shortsguard-adguardhome.txt.
Pi-hole → Adlists → paste the raw URL of blocklists/shortsguard-hosts.txt → Update gravity.
This blocks TikTok/Likee/Kwai/SnackVideo on every device. It cannot hide Reels/Shorts inside Facebook/Instagram/YouTube — use Focus Mode for that.
